_comment: Territories and their land markers (WAR_DESIGN.md section 2; server/realm.js). A point belongs to the nearest land marker in its worldspace. Whoever holds a marker owns its territory; at first every territory belongs to its zone's hold faction (guild-defs.json kind 'hold'). marker: the war standard's spot (world desc, position in game units, capture radius in units, 70 units = 1 m). The positions are the places' map markers in BSHeartland.esm (LCTN LCSR MapMarkerRefType, or the location centre for Aleswell), read 2026-09-26. kind 'capital' is the hold's seat: taking it takes the hold.
